text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Pyxel is an open-source fantasy console and game development framework inspired by early home computers and 8-bit gaming systems. Created for Python developers, it provides built-in tools for graphics, sound, input, and asset management while encouraging simple retro-style game creation. Pyxel uses a limited color palette and pixel-based design to recreate the constraints of classic hardware, making it popular for learning programming and creating small games.
